title: Italian Chef Fired for Refusing to Make Pineapple Pizza
paragraphs: Many Italians believe that pineapple should never be put on pizza. For one Italian chef in Australia, this belief may have cost him his job.

Davide Tamburella worked as a chef at La Costa, a restaurant in Brisbane, Australia. According to reports, he refused to make ham and pineapple pizzas for a private event. It was the third time in four years that he had refused to put pineapple on pizza. He felt that pineapple pizza was an insult to Italian culture.
On May 20, Tamburella lost his job. He then asked the Fair Work Commission, an Australian organization that deals with problems at work, to decide if he had been fired unfairly.

However, the restaurant's managers said that pineapple was not the only problem. They said there were also other problems, such as the way he spoke and communicated at work. Tamburella also said that a hand injury he got at work was part of the reason he was fired.
In the end, the Fair Work Commission did not decide whether his firing was fair or not. This was because he had sent his application too late.
The restaurant closed in July. Tamburella now works as the head chef at a different Italian restaurant in Brisbane. It does not serve pineapple pizza.
The story got a lot of attention online. Some people agreed with the chef, while others said a chef should make what customers ask for.
